# Your RSUs vested. Is the 22% your employer withheld enough?

> Free 2026 RSU withholding calculator: see how much federal tax your vest really adds versus the flat 22% your employer withholds, the shortfall you will owe in April, and the extra W-4 withholding per paycheck to close it. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
